title: Audit and isolate dynamic-link failure mitigation for GPU kernel loaders
text:
Audit and isolate dynamic-link failure mitigation for GPU kernel loaders

description:
Summary: We see intermittent runtime failures when dynamically loading GPU kernel components (Triton plugins, CUTLASS-backed shared objects) across our mixed CUDA 12/13 fleet. Failures surface as dlopen/dlsym errors, or silent symbol mismatch that causes a fallback to slower CPU code paths. This ticket audits symbol usage, isolates the dynamic loader, and implements mitigations (retry/backoff, diagnostic metadata, and a safe isolation mechanism) to reduce customer-facing fallbacks and improve stability.

goals:
1) Create a loader isolation strategy that prevents global symbol collisions from breaking other services. 2) Reduce runtime fallback incidents by 90% across our CUDA/Triton/CUTLASS matrix. 3) Add deterministic CI tests that catch ABI/symbol regressions. 4) Add observability (events/metrics/logs) to track loader failures and final outcome (success/fallback).

acceptance_criteria:
- Loader isolation implemented and enabled behind a runtime flag.
- DL load success rate >= 99.9% in CI matrix (cuda12/cuda13 x triton2/triton3).
- No p99 latency regressions >5% for steady-state generation workloads.
- Integration test covering failure injection (forced missing symbol) passes.
- Change reviewed and approved by runtime and infra owners.

approach:
1) Audit all dynamic symbols referenced by our plugin binaries (nm/objdump + ldd) and produce a minimal whitelist of required exported symbols. 2) Implement a loader shim that performs dlmopen to load plugins into isolated namespace when available; fall back to guarded dlopen with RTLD_NOW and symbol interposition checks on platforms without dlmopen. 3) Add an async retry + jitter for transient linking errors (3 attempts, exponential backoff) and surface structured diagnostics to logs/traces (loader.err_code, loader.linker_version, host_lib_versions). 4) Package a small ABI-guard library that provides symbol adapters for older CUTLASS helpers to reduce missing symbol cases. 5) Add CI jobs using CUDA 12/13 and Triton 2/3 images to run the loader smoke tests and memory-checks. 6) Instrument metrics: gpu.loader.loads, gpu.loader.fallbacks, gpu.loader.latency.

tradeoffs_and_risks:
- Using dlmopen provides strong isolation but is Linux-specific and not available on all distros; we'll detect availability at startup and document behavior.
- RTLD_DEEPBIND can avoid some collisions but breaks predictable interposition and can mask legitimate override behavior—avoid using it globally.
- ABI-guard adapters reduce immediate failures but add maintenance burden.
- Retry/backoff mitigates transient infra flakiness but can increase cold-start latency; retries controlled by flag and metric-gated.
- Changes touch low-level runtime; require careful rollout and monitoring to detect regressions quickly.

work_items:
- WIP: full symbol audit report (scripts + CSV)
- Implement loader shim: runtime/loader/isolate_loader.cc
- Add structured diagnostics and metrics to loader path
- Add CI matrix jobs and failure-injection tests
- Package ABI-guard shim and add to model onboarding scripts
- Docs: Confluence page with guidance and rollback steps
- Rollout plan: feature flag -> canary -> fleet-wide with automatic disable on error-rate spike

comments:
2025-02-12 - Anita Rao: Created ticket after triage with SRE and runtime. Reproduced on staging with a trimmed test harness that dlopens triton plugin built against CUDA12 on a CUDA13 host. Attached symbol diffs in Confluence.
2025-02-15 - Luca Martinez: Ran a full nm/ldd sweep across our plugin build artifacts. Found ~7 exported helper symbols from legacy cutlass_util that are sometimes unresolved when running newer driver stacks. Uploaded csv: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RUNTIME/SymbolAuditCSV
2025-02-18 - Priya Singh (MLE): Confirmed customer incident CI-2247 was caused by a missing helper symbol; customer saw 30-40% throughput drop when fallback occurred. Strong priority to reduce occurrence.
2025-02-22 - Luca Martinez: Implemented initial loader-shim that uses dlmopen when available. Local micro-benchmarks: fallback events reduced from 0.9% -> 0.12% on a synthetic mixed-model trace. P99 generation latency increased by ~2% due to additional checks.
2025-02-25 - Maya Chen (SRE): CI matrix job added to run the loader smoke tests on cuda12/cuda13 images. See CI run: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/runtime/runs/7812. Observed two flakes on a specific Ubuntu kernel; investigating libc version interactions.
2025-03-01 - Review feedback from Rajiv Patel: prefer dlmopen-based isolation but add a safe fallback that validates exported symbols after dlopen and exits gracefully with diagnostic tags. Also requested feature flag and metrics before wide rollout.
2025-03-03 - Luca Martinez: Addressed Rajiv's feedback; loader now emits loader.signature (build-id) and loader.host_abi tags. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2486. Scheduling canary (5% of dedicated fleets) for 2025-03-10.
